card.name: Dose-amount wording before per-day terms
card.fires_on: Words inside or right after a dose amount or a drug/system name, where the text is about to say per day, once daily, or a count of systems. Examples are the 'ast' in atorvastatin, 'mg' after a number, and 'trans' in transdermal.

modes.label: Inside drug and system names
modes.description: Partway through atorvastatin or transdermal system wording in warnings.
modes.example: Discontinue atorv<<ast>>atin calcium tablets if IMNM is suspected

modes.label: Unit after a dose number
modes.description: The unit word right after a number in dosing ranges, often followed by per day or once daily.
modes.example: Doses above 300<< mg>> did not give an increased blood pressure response

modes.label: Multiple systems or infusions
modes.description: Wording about several patches or a maintenance infusion.
modes.example: several transdermal systems may<< be>> used

card.writes: It pushes toward words meaning 'daily' or 'day and night' and away from words about total counts or quantities.
card.plain: It fires on dose amounts and drug names where the next words will likely say how often per day the drug is given.
